law: This sample code project shows you how to use your camera app with a DockKit accessory to frame and track subjects in real time.
To keep the user interface responsive, the app defines as an actor type to ensure that AVFoundation capture API calls don’t occur on the main thread.
When an accessory connects, DockKit sets it up to use system tracking, and to listen to accessory events and battery states in .
Use to perform animations, or explicitly control the position of the dock accessory in three-dimensional space by supplying coordinates in units of radians.
